contracts.signal: WEC 8-K (Item 1.01): on August 14, 2026 Wisconsin Electric Power Company entered into a PPA with NextEra Energy Point Beach LLC to purchase 86% of the capacity, energy, ancillary services and environmental attributes of Point Beach Units 1 and 2 for 20 years each - October 6, 2030 through October 5, 2050 for Unit 1 and March 9, 2033 through March 8, 2053 for Unit 2 - following the current PPA that expires October 5, 2030 (Unit 1) and March 8, 2033 (Unit 2). The PPA requires PSCW approval (either party may terminate if it is not obtained before January 1, 2028, automatically extended to July 1, 2028 if approval is still being pursued); WEC says that, if approved by the PSCW, the PPA will result in savings for customers compared with the current PPA.
contracts.units: 86% of Point Beach Units 1 and 2 output; 20-year terms
